text: Each AI agent gets its own Linux box (Sprite) that checkpoints itself automatically while the agent works
quote: Every agent gets its own Linux box. A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.

text: Sprites sleep when idle at zero compute cost and wake on request with their state intact
quote: Get a computer for every customer’s agent. It sleeps (at zero compute cost) until you wake it on request.

text: Run each MCP server in its own Sprite with persistent disk and an egress policy, paying only for tool calls used
quote: Run every MCP server in its own Sprite, with persistent disk, and egress policy. Pay only for the tool calls you use.

text: Run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, egress-locked, disposable VMs with a clean baseline for every request
quote: Run it in a hardware-isolated VM. A clean baseline per request, so no two users ever share state. Egress-locked and disposable.

text: Every Sprite gets an HTTPS URL, so apps built inside it go live in place with no migration
quote: Every Sprite has an HTTPS URL. The app your agent built stays exactly where it was created and goes live. Nobody migrates anything.

text: Roll back a Sprite to any checkpoint in seconds
quote: Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds

text: Sprite disk grows with use up to 100 GB, and you are billed only for bytes actually written
quote: Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there.

text: Connect an external service once at org level so every Sprite can reach it without anyone pasting tokens
quote: Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.

text: Scope service access by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint for least-privilege use
quote: Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint, so a Slack bot can post messages and never touch admin.

text: Rotate a credential once and every Sprite gets it, or revoke access for a single Sprite without affecting others
quote: Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential. Cut off a single Sprite and the rest never notice.

text: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second and scale out to tens of thousands of instances
quote: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.

text: The same primitives and API apply at every scale, with no rearchitecting or platform migration as you grow
quote: Keep the same primitives at every scale: no rearchitecting when you grow, and no platform migration when you get big. The API you start with is the API you keep.

text: Running `fly launch` in a project directory creates, configures, and deploys a new app
quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.

text: Fly Machines can be provisioned and managed through a REST API covering Apps, Machines, and Volumes
quote: The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.

text: Managed Postgres is a fully managed production PostgreSQL service
quote: Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases

text: Managed Postgres includes automatic backups and recovery
quote: Automatic backups and recovery

text: Managed Postgres provides high availability with automatic failover
quote: High availability with automatic failover

text: Managed Postgres supports the pgvector extension for vector similarity search
quote: The third party `pgvector` extension for vector similarity search

text: Deploy apps to regions worldwide, with users routed to the nearest server over a global Anycast network
quote: You can deploy apps in regions worldwide, so your users in Tokyo, São Paulo, or Amsterdam connect to the nearest server through our global Anycast network.

text: Pricing is pay-as-you-go for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use
quote: Unlike Heroku's dyno-based tiers, Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing - you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use.

text: The `fly doctor` command runs diagnostics on WireGuard, IPs, and Docker
quote: Run diagnostics: `fly doctor` — checks WireGuard, IPs, and Docker.

text: Secrets are encrypted, stored in a vault, and passed securely to apps
quote: Secrets allow sensitive values, such as credentials, to be passed securely to your Fly App. The secret is encrypted and stored in a vault.

text: The `fly scale` command scales apps horizontally and vertically
quote: the `fly scale` command for quick horizontal and vertical scaling

text: Run an Elixir cluster across servers worldwide and deploy to multiple regions with a single command
quote: Fly.io makes it easier to run an Elixir cluster on multiple servers around the world and deploy to those regions with a single command.

text: Configurable Machine restart policies control whether and how a Machine restarts after its process exits
quote: The Machine restart policy defines whether and how flyd restarts a Machine after its main process exits.

text: `fly machine run` configures, builds, and starts a new Machine in one command
quote: The `fly machine run` command is a tool to configure, build, and start a new Machine in one line.

text: flyctl can start an experimental MCP server
quote: [experimental] Start a flyctl MCP server

text: Convert Docker images into fast-booting VMs that run globally
quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally. This is great or ingesting incoming data!

text: Host web apps built by you or your agents, together with Postgres and storage
quote: Host the web apps you and your agents build, with Postgres and storage.

text: Run API backends on VMs in 18 regions, close to your users
quote: Run the APIs behind your product on VMs in 18 regions, close to your users.

text: Give an engineering team access to Claude Code and Codex running in the cloud
quote: Give your engineering team access to Claude Code and Codex in the cloud.

text: Run untrusted code, evals, and RL rollouts in parallel, checkpointing what works and discarding the rest
quote: Run untrusted code, evals, and RL rollouts in parallel. Checkpoint what works, throw away the rest.

text: Automatically generates a Dockerfile for popular frameworks such as Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, and .NET
quote: No Dockerfile? No problem: we'll generate one for most popular frameworks, including Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, .NET and more.

text: Ship apps either from GitHub or from the CLI using `fly launch`
quote: Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.

text: Fly Launch can use a project's existing Dockerfile
quote: If your project already has one, Fly Launch can use it instead.

text: The `fly` CLI creates and deploys apps, manages Machines and volumes, and configures networking
quote: You’ll use the `fly` command to create and deploy apps, manage Machines and volumes, configure networking, and more.

text: Directly create and destroy Machines with control over each one's lifecycle, resources, and region placement
quote: You can create and destroy Machines directly, and you have control over every Machine’s lifecycle, resources, and region placement.

text: List available regions with `fly platform regions`
quote: Run `fly platform regions` to get a list of regions.

text: Host a remote MCP server reachable over HTTP that stops when idle, either multi-tenant or as one app per user
quote: Host a remote MCP server on a Fly Machine that any MCP client can reach over HTTP and that stops when idle, as a multi-tenant app or one app per user.

text: Launch an MCP stdio server and add an MCP proxy client to an MCP client configuration
quote: Add MCP proxy client to a MCP client configuration

text: Run GPUs on Fly.io while editing the app on your local machine
quote: For those of us who don’t have the hardware locally, we can run a GPU on Fly.io while editing the app on our machine.

text: Sprites are disposable cloud computers that appear instantly, include durable filesystems, and cost almost nothing when idle
quote: Sprites are disposable cloud computers. They appear instantly, always include durable filesystems, and cost practically nothing when idle.

text: Support is provided by Fly.io engineers rather than chatbots
quote: Run by Fly.io engineers, not chat bots

text: Provides a production-readiness checklist to catch common pitfalls for apps
quote: This checklist is meant to catch common pitfalls for apps on Fly.io, but it's not a guarantee of production readiness.

text: Framework-specific documentation is available for different tech stacks
quote: Check out the docs specific to your tech so you can move faster.

text: Guide for running Hermes on a Fly Machine and reaching its web dashboard from a laptop
quote: This guide walks you through running Hermes on a Fly Machine, configuring it, and reaching its web dashboard from your laptop.
